traceContract.format: Schema-level CPM semantic trace with one current sender stationId, one PerceivedObject.objectId, one SensorInformation.sensorId, monotonic reception time, and xCm per frame.

interpretation: No rotation kept one sender shard, one mapping, and one LDM record with no duplicate, ghost, or missing object.

Synchronized station/object/sensor rotation started a fresh sender shard but retained the old shard and old LDM record, ending with two mappings and two LDM records for the one-physical-object trace: one duplicate and one ghost immediately after rotation.
The intentionally incomplete station-only rotation also duplicated the record because the object-ID collision branch allocated LDM ID 1; this is a negative control and not standards evidence.
receiveCPM applied no hard reset hook. The observable current behavior is new-station shard creation plus residual old cache/LDM state.
Missing stayed zero in these one-object, no-loss traces because a current-pseudonym record was inserted.

controls.receiverAndScorerSeparation: Rotation metadata was used only after execution to label residual records; receiveCPM received only current-frame CPM fields.
controls.stationOnlyTracePurpose: Explicit standards-negative control for incomplete rotation; it was not pooled with the synchronized trace.
controls.deterministicCrossCheck: The compiled C++ output matched the independent JavaScript transition model field for field.
controls.hardResetObservable: A true hard reset would remove prior sender mappings and associated LDM state. The observed official path did neither; applied=false is therefore reported rather than inferred continuity.

limitations: Full VaN3Twin CMake configuration was blocked by missing required OpenCV before libautomotive could compile; the host also lacked the other recorded packages and passwordless sudo.
The conformance harness compiled exact official receiver/cache method bodies but not the full linked application, network decoder, full coordinate conversion, or timeout scheduler.
Trace validity was checked at the CPM field-contract level; ASN.1 constraints and UPER round-trip validity were not executed.
The trace had one physical object and no packet loss, omission, ambiguity, or silent period, so this is an execution gate rather than the full minimumExecutableStudy.
Ghost and duplicate labels used scorer-side knowledge that each trace contained one physical object; that knowledge was not available to receiver code.
Immediate residuals were measured through 300 ms. The statically audited one-second LDM cleanup path was not compiled or exercised.

An initial full-history clone was stopped after sustained low-throughput download; the successful replacement was an exact-commit depth-one fetch. The only build replacement was the official-method conformance harness after the full build hit missing system dependencies.
